# Ritik Patni

> Frontend developer and wildlife/macro photographer. This is a two-persona site: a "studio" developer profile (engineering notes, blog, journal) and a "field" photography profile (gallery, book library). Switch personas via the Dev/Photo toggle in the header.

## Studio (Developer)
- Journal: https://ritikpatni.me/coding/
- Notes (blog): https://ritikpatni.me/blog/
- About: https://ritikpatni.me/about/

## Field (Photography)
- Gallery: https://ritikpatni.me/photography/
- Library / Archive: https://ritikpatni.me/library/
